neighbours.label: the punctuation or connective between short parallel clauses with the same subject (I read, I planned, and; it is clever; it is new)
fire: We cook dinner, we wash the plates, we go to bed.
She sings, she dances, and she plays three instruments.
It is loud; it is crowded; it is the best bar in town.
You can walk to the station, or you can take the bus.
He runs, he swims, he lifts weights every morning.
They laughed, they cried, and they hugged at the door.
It was cold; it was dark; it was nearly midnight.
I wrote, I edited, and I printed every page myself.
quiet: We cook dinner and wash the plates before bed.
She sings and dances while playing three instruments.
It is a loud and crowded bar and the best in town.
You can reach the station by walking or by bus.
He runs and swims and lifts weights every morning.
They laughed and cried and hugged at the door.
It was a cold and dark night near midnight.
I wrote and edited and printed every page myself.

notes: Card: ',' x20, '.' x4, ' or' x4, ';' x2, ' and', ' And', all between repeated clause frames. Probes: 'we make breakfast,' 0.772, ';' 0.601, 'I read,' 0.598, ', or we can' 0.382; the same content in a single clause under 0.05. Near misses keep the words without the parallel repetition.
